pages.text:
Sure, there are numbers to time it. With 360 hp pumping through a 2.5 TFSI®
five-cylinder and streamlined styling, the TT RS Coupe achieves 0–60 in 4.1
seconds.1 That’s a blistering number, of course, but it’s a bit of a narrow view
of what this sports car delivers. In terms of pure engine output, it promises
to take no prisoners with a riveting exhaust note that plays when you hit the
throttle. Its lightweight design enables more than straight line speed, and
some serious stopping power. And poised for acceleration, you might think its
upper limit is the last few feet of the exosphere. But assuming you stay road-
bound, the only limits you might encounter are the ones mandated by law.
Don’t think stopwatch,
think countdown.
.18 – 6-speed Manual Transmission
Staying true to its high-performance
roots, the TT RS Coupe comes equipped
with a six-speed manual transmission,
specifically designed for quick gear shifts
and a deeper connection to the road.
European model shown.
360
hp
.19 – 2.5L Five-cylinder TFSI® Engine
It’s not just the 360 hp and 343 lb-ft of torque the 2.5L TFSI® produces that
make the TT RS engine a serious performer, it’s how that kinetic potential is
delivered. With a lightweight ASF® aluminum space frame girding the vehicle, an
ultraresponsive six-speed manual transmission and a design that helps reduce the
drag coefficient to a very low .32, the TT RS uses its direct-injected, turbocharged
power plant with a lusty efficiency,2 moving weight faster than bulkier frames with
bigger engines. It is an agile, intelligent distribution of power that takes nothing
away from the throttle–but only adds to its overall performance.

.21 – Audi Navigation Plus
The intuitive Audi Navigation
plus is avail able to help ensure
you’ll be able to quickly input
your next destination with
minimum distraction. And
with the Audi real-time traffic
feature, you can bet you’ll get
there without the gridlock.1
.22 – B L uETooTH®
Staying connected has never
been more important. That’s
why your TT features available
BLUETOOTH® mobile phone
connectivity for simple, hands-
free functionality. With a
simple push of a button on the
steering wheel you can make
and receive calls.
.23 – Satellite Radio
With more than 180 channels,
you can drive from coast to
coast and never run out of
something to listen to. From
music to news to talk radio,
it’s a good bet that SiriusXM
Satellite Radio has whatever
you’re in the mood for.
.24 – Audi Music Interface
Now you’re in control. The
available Audi music interface
helps give you seamless iPod®
integration. Your iPod® can be
controlled through the audio
system and steering controls,
and with two standard SD card
slots for your MP3 music, your
entertainment options just
keep getting better.
1 See Navigation disclaimer on Tech nology page of Specifications section.

--- page 16 ---
Sure, there are numbers to time it. With 360 hp pumping through a 2.5 TFSI®
five-cylinder and streamlined styling, the TT RS Coupe achieves 0–60 in 4.1
seconds.1 That’s a blistering number, of course, but it’s a bit of a narrow view
of what this sports car delivers. In terms of pure engine output, it promises
to take no prisoners with a riveting exhaust note that plays when you hit the
throttle. Its lightweight design enables more than straight line speed, and
some serious stopping power. And poised for acceleration, you might think its
upper limit is the last few feet of the exosphere. But assuming you stay road-
bound, the only limits you might encounter are the ones mandated by law.
Don’t think stopwatch,
think countdown.
.18 – 6-speed Manual Transmission
Staying true to its high-performance
roots, the TT RS Coupe comes equipped
with a six-speed manual transmission,
specifically designed for quick gear shifts
and a deeper connection to the road.
European model shown.
360
hp
.19 – 2.5L Five-cylinder TFSI® Engine
It’s not just the 360 hp and 343 lb-ft of torque the 2.5L TFSI® produces that
make the TT RS engine a serious performer, it’s how that kinetic potential is
delivered. With a lightweight ASF® aluminum space frame girding the vehicle, an
ultraresponsive six-speed manual transmission and a design that helps reduce the
drag coefficient to a very low .32, the TT RS uses its direct-injected, turbocharged
power plant with a lusty efficiency,2 moving weight faster than bulkier frames with
bigger engines. It is an agile, intelligent distribution of power that takes nothing
away from the throttle–but only adds to its overall performance.

.21 – Audi Navigation Plus
The intuitive Audi Navigation
plus is avail able to help ensure
you’ll be able to quickly input
your next destination with
minimum distraction. And
with the Audi real-time traffic
feature, you can bet you’ll get
there without the gridlock.1
.22 – B L uETooTH®
Staying connected has never
been more important. That’s
why your TT features available
BLUETOOTH® mobile phone
connectivity for simple, hands-
free functionality. With a
simple push of a button on the
steering wheel you can make
and receive calls.
.23 – Satellite Radio
With more than 180 channels,
you can drive from coast to
coast and never run out of
something to listen to. From
music to news to talk radio,
it’s a good bet that SiriusXM
Satellite Radio has whatever
you’re in the mood for.
.24 – Audi Music Interface
Now you’re in control. The
available Audi music interface
helps give you seamless iPod®
integration. Your iPod® can be
controlled through the audio
system and steering controls,
and with two standard SD card
slots for your MP3 music, your
entertainment options just
keep getting better.
1 See Navigation disclaimer on Tech nology page of Specifications section.
